verdict.rationale: User-configured background automation is a fair axis for a payroll/HR SaaS platform, so it applies. The evidence only shows Gusto-operated compliance services: state tax registration, annual report filing, government mail monitoring and proactive deadline alerts. These are managed services Gusto runs for the customer, not automations the user can set up, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. Nothing in the pack documents user-defined workflows, triggers or agentic background tasks.
